name: VELOCITY
recent: Velocity Capital Partner Berhad 近期发生多项董事与委员会人事变动，并发出第25届常年股东大会通知（含修订）。公司同时公布截至2026年6月30日止季度业绩，并披露提供财务援助。
notable: 委任新董事及审计、风险、薪酬委员会成员变动。
发出第25届常年股东大会通知（修订版）。
披露向关联方提供财务援助。
risks: 季度净利同比大幅下降79.0%，环比下降23.5%。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为9,044,000令吉，同比减少11.2%，环比增长5.7%；净利为1,735,000令吉，同比减少79.0%，环比减少23.5%；净利率为19.2%，低于上一季度的26.5%。

recent_en: Velocity Capital Partner Berhad saw several board and committee changes and issued an addendum to its 25th AGM notice. It also announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 and disclosed the provision of financial assistance.
notable_en: Appointment of new directors and changes in Audit, Risk and Remuneration Committee memberships.
Issued an addendum to the notice of the 25th Annual General Meeting.
Disclosed the provision of financial assistance.
risks_en: Quarterly net profit fell 79.0% year-on-year and 23.5% quarter-on-quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 9,044,000, down 11.2% year-on-year but up 5.7% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 1,735,000, down 79.0% year-on-year and 23.5% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 19.2%, lower than 26.5% in the previous quarter.
